text:
morgan: Heads-up for this week's release train: introducing a safety-net rollback automation and tightening exception process. Please ack when you see.

morgan: TL;DR: auto-rollback rule for P95 regressions >20% or sustained error-rate >2% for 3m during canary; freeze window unchanged (Sat 00:00 - Mon 06:00 UTC). Exceptions require release lead + eng-sre signoff and a short rollback/playbook in the PR.

morgan: New canary window for this sprint: Fri 01:00-05:00 UTC. Owners, please follow the checklist before flipping.

morgan: Checklist (short):
- run `ci/release-smoke` and `ci/perf-smoke`
- confirm P95 <= baseline * 1.12 unless model has approved delta
- error-rate < 1% sustained post-flip for 5m
- add label `release:safety-net` if you want automatic rollback enabled

tara: Ack. Where's the document for rollback playbooks?

morgan: Playbook template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollback.md (eng-release + eng-sre). Fill in expected mitigation steps in the PR description when requesting exception.

vikram: Small note: for heavy-token services we should allow an extended warmup period. Will auto-rollback kick in during gradual ramp?

morgan: Good question. Auto-rollback is evaluated after staged ramp steps complete for a stage; during a staged ramp we sample per-stage P95 and err-rate. If any stage crosses thresholds the automation will pause the ramp and notify eng-sre for manual review; it will only auto-rollback if the full-canary metrics exceed thresholds after the stage window. Tag `release:extended-canary` for staged ramps.

sre-bot: CI update: added `check:rollback-safety` hook and `metric-watcher` for train-1799. Notifications routed to #eng-oncall and the PR thread. :satellite: 

release-bot: Policy note: disabling the safety-net automation requires written approval from release leads + eng-sre and an explicit mitigation plan. See /policies/auto-rollback.

ops-bot: CLI for emergency opt-out (audit logged):
```n/optout --policy auto-rollback --reason "hotfix" --owner @your-name
```
(ops approval in-thread required within 20m)

vikram: I'll mark the embedding rollout `release:extended-canary` and schedule two-stage ramp.

tara: One small ask: canary flip one-liner please include canary id, model, P95, err, and a short tag whether safety-net is enabled. Example: `canary=3472 | model=embed-v2 | state=up | t=12m | p95=420ms | err=0.3% | safety-net=on`.

morgan: Yes please follow that format. Makes it easier for oncall to triage quickly.

sre-bot: Reminder: if safety-net triggers a rollback, an automated incident note will be created with diffs of P50/P95 and recent traces. Owners should add a short retrospective comment in the PR.

release-bot: Note: reverting to previous gating rules or disabling safety-net requires formal signoff. Refer to /policies/release-gates and tag @morgan + @sre-lead.

vikram: PR #5345 uploaded with staged ramp plan and rollback playbook. Running `ci/perf-smoke` now.

tara: Acked. I'll update the release calendar and add a short blurb to the weekly changelog tomorrow with canary outcomes and any safety-net activations.

morgan: Action items summary:
- owners: run both smoke jobs, label PRs appropriately, include rollback playbook when asking for exceptions
- eng-sre: watch metric-watcher and be ready to approve exceptions or investigate safety-net triggers
- release leads: approve any policy exceptions in-thread with mitigation

ops-bot: smoke pipeline updated for train-1799: `check:perf-smoke`, `check:rollback-safety`, `check:dedicated-route`. :white_check_mark: 

vikram: `ci/perf-smoke` passed locally; uploading canary candidate.

morgan: thanks. If anyone hits blockers ping @morgan or escalate in #eng-oncall. I'll post a concise changelog tomorrow with final canary outcome and any rollbacks.
